answer.justification: Every logit measurement is exactly zero or one: top-1 and sequence agreement are 1.000, and KL, TV and the Token-DiFR gap are all 0.000. The raw-score shift ÷ TV is undefined (0 ÷ 0), which is the signature of the 'none' class. Quantization, the closest alternative, would show KL around 0.05, TV around 0.05 and top-1 agreement around 0.95. All other classes show even larger logit changes. Output and activation levels were not available to confirm this.
